name: grab adhesive
definition: high-tack construction adhesive from a cartridge that holds on contact.
notes: Toolstation category Grab Adhesive; Tooled-Up lists Pinkgrip solvent-free grab adhesive

name: general adhesive or glue
definition: general-purpose glue for household and building repairs.
notes: Tooled-Up subcategories All Purpose Adhesive and General Glue

name: wood glue
definition: adhesive made to bond wood (PVA and others).
notes: Tooled-Up subcategory Wood Glue (PVA and resin wood adhesives)

name: wallpaper adhesive
definition: paste for hanging wallpaper.
notes: Tooled-Up subcategory Wallpaper & Border Adhesives

name: tile adhesive
definition: adhesive for fixing wall and floor tiles (C-12).
notes: Tooled-Up Tiling Adhesives; Toolstation Mapei wall and floor tile adhesives

name: sealant (caulk)
definition: flexible compound that seals joints and gaps against water and air.
notes: Toolstation Silicone & Sealants category (building, sanitary, general, fire)

name: tile grout
definition: compound that fills the joints between tiles (C-12).
notes: Toolstation Mapei brand page sells wall and floor grout

name: AA cell
definition: cylindrical cell of IEC size R6 (aliases LR6, UM-3, Mignon, penlight).
notes: AA 1.5 V alkaline sold singly or in packs

name: AAA cell
definition: cylindrical cell of IEC size R03.
notes: AAA 1.5 V alkaline packs

name: C cell
definition: cylindrical cell of IEC size R14.
notes: C 1.5 V alkaline cell sold each or in tens

name: D cell
definition: cylindrical cell of IEC size R20.
notes: D 1.5 V alkaline cell sold each or in tens

name: CR123A cell
definition: 3 V primary lithium cylindrical cell used in lights and cameras.
notes: CR123A 3 V lithium; aliases CR17345, DL123A, EL123A; 17 x 34.5 mm

name: 18650 cell
definition: lithium-ion cylindrical cell 18 mm by 65 mm, sold loose.
notes: Nkon lists 18650 cells loose, some protected, by model and capacity

name: 21700 cell
definition: lithium-ion cylindrical cell 21 mm by 70 mm, sold loose.
notes: Nkon lists 21700 cells loose, some protected, by model and capacity

name: coin cell
definition: flat button or coin cell (designations such as CR2032 are named forms).
notes: Bunnings lists 2032, 2016, 2450 lithium, LR44/A76 and 377 button cells

name: 9 V battery
definition: rectangular 9 V battery with snap terminals (IEC 6F22 and kin).
notes: 9 volt alkaline sold each or in packs

name: battery charger for standard-size cells
definition: charger for loose standard cells such as AA, AAA and 18650 (K-3).
notes: Household chargers for AA/AAA NiMH; some also take 18650 or C and D

name: LPG cylinder
definition: refillable propane or butane bottle, owned or leased (`gas` and `valve` attributes; K-30).
notes: Mitre10 sells OnGas 9 kg and Number 8 4 kg LPG cylinders (full or swap)

name: gas canister
definition: small disposable gas canister for stoves, torches and lighters (K-30, K-166).
notes: Weber disposable canister EN417 valve; Coleman C500 screw-valve cartridge

name: firewood logs
definition: split logs sold for burning (kiln-dried an attribute).
notes: Kiln dried hardwood logs sold in nets

name: kindling
definition: small dry sticks for starting a fire.
notes: Kindling sold in bags for starting wood, coal or solid fuel fires

name: coal
definition: coal or manufactured smokeless fuel sold in bags.
notes: Manufactured smokeless coal sold in 25-bag packs

name: charcoal briquettes
definition: moulded briquettes of compressed charcoal for barbecues.
notes: Briquettes by Weber and Heat Beads, in 4 to 10 kg bags

name: lump charcoal
definition: natural lumpwood charcoal (binchotan included).
notes: Lumpwood charcoal incl. Kasai Sumi Bincho

name: wood pellets
definition: compressed wood pellets for pellet grills, stoves and boilers.
notes: Hardwood pellets for pellet grills in 8 to 12 kg bags

name: smoking chips and chunks
definition: wood chips or chunks for smoking food, by wood species.
notes: Wood chunks by wood species (apple, manuka) in litre packs

name: lubricant
definition: general oil, grease or penetrating lubricant sold in a can or tube.
notes: Screwfix Lubricants: multi-use, penetrating, silicone, grease

name: lighter fluid
definition: liquid fuel for refilling lighters or lighting barbecues.
notes: Zippo Lighter Fluid listed with BBQ fuel at Mitre10

name: fuel can
definition: container made to carry and store fuel.
notes: Tooled-Up Jerry Cans category of metal fuel cans

name: firelighter
definition: block, cube or bag of fuel made to start a fire.
notes: Zip odourless firelighters, wrapper-lit

name: match
definition: safety or strike-anywhere match.
notes: Swan Vestas 5-pack safety matches, EN1783

name: long utility lighter
definition: long-nozzle lighter for barbecues, stoves and fires (pocket lighters are B9).
notes: Tractor Supply sells extra long utility lighter under Charcoal Starters & Lighters; 14 in. nozzle

name: candle lighter
definition: long lighter made to light candles.
notes: ManoMano Lighters: electric USB arc candle lighter with flexible neck

name: lighter flint
definition: replacement flint for a lighter (K-166).
notes: Zippo flint and wick co-pack, replacement flints for windproof lighters

name: parcel tape
definition: wide adhesive tape for sealing parcels and boxes.
notes: HuntOffice Packing Tape: polypropylene 48/50 mm x 66 m rolls

name: bubble wrap
definition: plastic sheet of air bubbles for cushioning goods.
notes: HuntOffice Bubble Wrap: Jiffy and Sealed Air AirCap rolls

name: stretch film
definition: clinging plastic film wound round goods or pallets.
notes: HuntOffice Shrink Wrap and Stretch Film: hand rolls from 100 mm

name: void fill
definition: loose fill, paper or air pillows packed round goods in a box.
notes: iPack names void fill; Uline sells Storopack air pillow film as void fill

name: packing box
definition: cardboard box sold flat for packing or moving (boxes made for storing things are B1).
notes: HuntOffice Cardboard Packing Boxes, flat-packed single and double wall
